dog.description_text:
Hi! My name is Ripley. I'm a very affectionate playful pup. I get excited playing with my foster brothers. Riley is now an indoor pup. He is good on leash in the house. He sleeps and eats well. Hes not crate trained or pot trained yet. But he learns very easily.

He loves to play and be curious. His energy is a 8. And will sleep and nap after he's played. He loves to snuggle up and watch a movie too. He has slept through the night . He only barks a bit. But we are learning not to do. I think mostly out of excitement.

He is good with kids. But he still has his puppy teeth. So a bit sharp. I think he'd be a perfect companion with or without another dog in the house.
dog.name: Ripley
